column3: Implemented over ai events joined to http requests by request or trace id (AiUsageByRoute.java:63-264); the http producer (W5a P-http, RequestCorrelationFilter.publish) now supplies the route; joins without BootUI's time window; deviations: envelope executionId, threadKind and failedOrSlow absent; resources, timing and asyncStarted not ported; extra route label (BootUI derives it at read time with RouteLabel.of); operation null; traceId only from a valid traceparent (null otherwise, as BootUI); path carries path-parameter values as HttpPayload.path does (masked at read)
